The cat heredoc had leading indents which caused invalid syntax or EOF issue. Let's execute Python directly via base64 encoded command or plain string without heredoc indentation.
```python
res = await run_command("python -c \"import yt_dlp; info = yt_dlp.YoutubeDL({'skip_download': True}).extract_info('https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L1vXCYZAYYM', download=False); print('TITLE:', info.get('title')); print('DESC:', info.get('description'))\"")
print(res)
```
